随着祂的靠近，巨大而缠结的纯灵能线团被突然驯服。泥沼变得清晰易懂，色彩绽放出新的定义。对称、逻辑和结构都得到了加强。

texts.en:
The Shroud's seething ebullition pulsates before us. An intractable presence approaches; it is the Vacant Throne.

As it nears, vast and knotted coils of raw psionic energy are suddenly tamed. The morass becomes clearer and more comprehensible. Colors bloom with newfound definition. Symmetry, logic, and structure are imposed.

Something forms within the deepest recess of our minds: a far-reaching desire for order.

summary.text:
# 由乱到治 / Chaos into Order

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- DLC：Shadows of the Shroud

## 如何开始 How it starts

潜入虚境但没有找到其他事件（on_patron_delve_failed）时，从28个权重各为100的遭遇（另有权重1的 utopia.3002 兜底）中随机抽取一个满足条件的；每次潜入失败只出现一个遭遇，不会依次经历全部。要求与小赞助者“空置之御座”已完成接触、未在“自寻出路”、处于喰煞或器具领域之一，每个帝国一次。

When a Shroud delve finds nothing else (on_patron_delve_failed), one eligible encounter is drawn at random from 28 candidates of weight 100 each (plus utopia.3002 at weight 1 as fallback); each failed delve shows one encounter, never all of them in sequence. Requires completed contact with the minor patron the Vacant Throne, not forging its own path, and being in the domain of the Eater or the Instrument; once per empire.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

空置之御座驯服了混乱的灵能。

The Vacant Throne tames chaotic psionic energy.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一选项：解锁法令“秩序之意”。

Only option: unlocks the edict Will of Order.
